description: Registry of MCP servers wired into the hitcon-range-sprint agent framework. Source of truth; see README.md for the wiring policy.

policy.import_mode: reference external snapshot (Security-LabData/external-mcp-tools/<name>) and pin upstream commit, release version, and any submodule commit; do not vendor server source
policy.holder_node: Primary Analysis Gateway (host LabStrix), in a dedicated version-pinned runtime; never the host default interpreter when deps pin an older Python
policy.secrets: environment variables only; never committed; registry records variable names, not values

retired.name: semgrep-mcp
retired.reason: Upstream deprecated semgrep-mcp 0.9.0; its tools/list exposed only the deprecation_notice tool. Superseded by the `semgrep mcp` subcommand built into semgrep.

servers.name: semgrep
servers.purpose: Current Semgrep MCP server (OSS engine) exposed via the `semgrep mcp` subcommand for code-security scanning.

source.note: server code is bundled in the semgrep package at semgrep/mcp/server.py; no external snapshot or submodule

env: SEMGREP_APP_TOKEN (optional; for platform findings, remote, and Pro features)

servers.pinned_by: semgrep 1.178.0 ships cp314 wheels, so the host default interpreter runs it natively

servers.name: cve-mcp-server
servers.purpose: CVE/vulnerability intelligence MCP server spanning 20+ sources (NVD, EPSS, CISA KEV, OSV, GitHub Advisory, ...) with a triage_cve orchestrator; aligns with the framework CVE/EPSS/KEV/CVSS research line.

source.snapshot_note: working tree has 2 deleted tracked files (src/cve_mcp/server.py, src/cve_mcp/api/report_generator.py); restored from HEAD into a scratch copy; snapshot itself untouched

extra_hard_deps: mcp<2 (snapshot declares mcp[cli]>=1.7.0 which resolves to mcp 2.x and breaks: FastMCP renamed to MCPServer)
